scope: production broker-consensus factor mapping and snapshot metadata only

old_behavior: manual_pdf, manual_csv or imported_pdf ingestion mode could set lawful=true without an explicit factor-use grant
brokerIsLawful evaluated lawful=true before licenseStatus=blocked or unknown, so a convenience flag could override an explicit negative status
rebuilt broker snapshots labeled user-supplied/imported documents as an authorization basis without a separate license status
finding.risk: Unlicensed or explicitly blocked broker summaries could contribute up to 100 broker-evidence points and raise a candidate's research score.

repair.mapping: Only licenseStatus licensed or permitted sets lawful=true. Ingestion modes remain provenance and do not grant factor use.
repair.precedence: Explicit blocked or unknown status returns false before any compatibility flag is considered.
repair.legacy_boundary: Rows with no explicit licenseStatus may still use the historical freshness=licensed representation or a previously validated lawful flag; any explicit blocked/unknown value wins.

new_regression_assertions: three manual/import modes without explicit permission all map to lawful=false
explicit blocked cannot be overridden by lawful=true
explicit unknown cannot be overridden by lawful=true
explicit permitted with two sources still produces the expected 75 evidence grade

research_effect.reason: S7 was already blocked and no broker feature entered the preserved price-strategy run.

operational_effect.required_after_reviewed_deployment: Rebuild broker consensus snapshots through the guarded pipeline; rows remain non-scoring until an explicit licensed/permitted status backed by a factor-use grant is supplied.
